title: GO Command Center CONTROL_STATUS_V1
description: The compact, stable, read-only query contract a ChatGPT connector reads instead of the underlying JSON. Scope: CONTROL_STATE_AND_STATUS_ONLY. Bounded in size, fixed question keys, no execution parameter, and it can neither create nor sign a Task.

hk_agent_recent_activity.description: Q1: the newest signed CONTROL_PLANE_HEALTH Evidence at any age. Activity, never liveness.

active_tasks.description: Q2: tasks published and still inside their validity window.

last_task.description: Q3: the newest signed Task of any class.

pr_tested.description: Q4/Q5: look up by_pr_number for a specific pull request.

repository_declared_runtime.description: Q7: what the repository declares. A declaration is never the truth about what is running.

live_verified_runtime.description: Q8: the image named by the newest VERIFY Evidence.

stuck_tasks.description: Q9: answer reads active_stuck_tasks only. Expired history never affects current health.

last_failure.description: Q10: kind is FAILED_RECORD or EXPIRED_WITHOUT_EVIDENCE.

request_channel.description: known_capability vs currently_enabled_request_action. ChatGPT may use enabled actions only.

x-go-notes: answers.hk_agent_online is derived only from fresh signed CONTROL_PLANE_HEALTH Evidence. answers.hk_agent_recent_activity reports the last signed activity at any age and is explicitly NOT liveness.
answers.repository_declared_runtime and answers.live_verified_runtime are separate objects. A repository pointer can never make the live runtime PROVEN.
answers.stuck_tasks.answer reads active_stuck_tasks only; recently and historically expired tasks are reported separately and never change the current-health answer.
answers.request_channel distinguishes known_capability from currently_enabled_request_action. The connector may create Request files only for enabled actions.
answers.repository_main_sha is UNKNOWN unless it was supplied out of band; the runtime's build-source SHA is never substituted for it.
This contract contains no image override, service name, compose path, shell command or signing parameter.
